Phase-13.NAME: GitHubReleasePrep
Phase-13.purpose: Prepare MAGRA for its first GitHub release from the official anyagixx/MAGRA repository.

steps.step-1: Set canonical repository, bugs, homepage, and README badge URLs to anyagixx/MAGRA.
steps.step-2: Set the MAGRA package version to 0.1.0 for the first standalone product release.
steps.step-3: Document branch main and annotated tag v0.1.0 as the release publication path.
steps.step-4: Preserve Reasonix links only as upstream attribution or compatibility context.
